noun_definition: log in refers to the process of accessing the app by entering user credentials, which can be followed by logging out to test the functionality of the app's response to the 'Didn't receive a magic code' link.
App refers to the software application being used for logging in, which is expected to reset focus to the first digit when a specific link is clicked.
Digit refers to the individual numeric input field in the app's login interface that users interact with during the authentication process.
Click refers to the action of pressing the 'Didn't received a magic code' link in the app to trigger a response.
magic code refers to a verification code sent to the user for logging into the app, which is expected to be received and used during the login process.
